newsitem.title: USA: Metromail unit to offer on-line directory.
newsitem.headline: Metromail unit to offer on-line directory.

text.p: Metromail Corp said Monday its On-Line Services division signed an agreement with Southern New England Telephone (SNET), a unit of Southern New England Telecommunications Corp, to offer access to the company's National Directory Assistance service.
The pact will allow SNET telephone operators to have direct on-line access to a database of residential, business and government telephone listings anywhere in the country, On-Line Services said.
Metromail provides database marketing, direct marketing and reference services and products nationwide.
Its shares were unchanged Monday at 18.
